queries.query: Find interpreter or script activity that attempts to suppress, bypass, or weaken its own execution telemetry.
Find activity establishing persistence through a scheduled task, service, startup mechanism, or recurring hidden interpreter execution.
Find activity creating an identity, credential, access key, or privileged group membership.
Find endpoint discovery, address-range scanning, or commands that disable firewall or endpoint protections.
Find activity that downloads or transfers remote content and then executes, launches, or stages it.
Find failed or denied cloud compute provisioning activity, especially repeated attempts across scopes or regions.
Find changes that make object-storage data publicly accessible or later restrict that access.
Find unusual authentication failures, account misuse, or successful access following repeated denial.
Find email delivery or mailbox activity involving suspicious attachments, links, forwarding, or search and export behavior.
Find creation, modification, or access of executable content, credential material, or other sensitive files.
Find unusual name-resolution behavior, repetitive encoded-looking queries, or requests associated with command-and-control activity.
Find unusual data-store reads, writes, administrative operations, or attempts to alter protected information.
Find security detections describing exploitation, malicious execution, credential access, persistence, or exfiltration.
Find configuration state that weakens logging, access controls, encryption, exposure safeguards, or defensive policy.
Find spacecraft propulsion calibration activity performed during an orbital maintenance window.
